sources.title: GitHub - euzu/tuliprox: Flexible IPTV playlist processor & proxy in ...
sources.snippet: tuliprox is a high-performance IPTV proxy and playlist processor written in Rust 🦀. It unifies M3U/M3U8 playlists, Xtream providers, Stalker/Ministra portals, Plex, Emby, Jellyfin and local media, reshapes them into clean outputs, and serves them to IPTV players and media clients from one place.
